scope: Owner-approved parallel acceptance workflow; a harness follow-up, not D3 completion or a release gate.
runtime: Existing Codex workspace bundle; no runtime installation for this workflow.

checks.observed: No new owner actions after the initial item is acknowledged

acceptance: AWAITING_OWNER requires committed verified agent evidence and green exact-commit CI; pending phone checks are never PASS.
Explicitly permitted dependent work can start while the owner check waits, and unexplained source drift cannot reuse an old acceptance.
Wrong-build or contradictory owner audit reports, owner-requested fixes and unapproved prerequisite exceptions refuse continuation/completion.
Integration gates reject both the new awaiting-owner permission and legacy incomplete-predecessor exceptions.
Resume resets the readiness proof and owner check while preserving prior reports.
Owner report writes refuse junction/symlink escapes; completed milestones cannot receive new unfinishable owner acceptance requests.
Reminder acknowledgement rejects a changed snapshot, preventing a concurrent addition from being silently acknowledged.

reminder.policy: Notify on new or changed outstanding owner actions; quiet while unchanged. Agents also announce additions in their current chat.

limitations: D3 remains IN_PROGRESS: final D3 reviews/verification/CI and an actual Android report are still required before its handoff and completion.
The first owner item is NEEDS_SETUP, not a ready phone-test build.
No browser suite, device PASS, deployment or remote CI run for this follow-up checkpoint is claimed.
